Tensorlake npm release ran a credential-stealing worm

Target: Tensorlake · repo
Date: 2026-10-07
Target Kind: library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: compromised_account_credentials
Impact: credential_theft, remote_code_execution

Synopsis

The official tensorlake 0.5.144 npm release added a preinstall loader. Installing the SDK with lifecycle scripts enabled launched a worm that stole credentials and attempted further propagation.
